--agent-cls.help: Name of the default agent to use

--agent-config.help: Replace default Agent ([agent] section in config.toml) config with the specified Agent config, e.g. "CodeAct" for [agent.CodeAct] section in config.toml

--align-with-max.help: Whether to align failed instances with max iteration count (true/false)

--base-dir.help: Base directory to search for final_report.json files (default: evaluation/evaluation_outputs/outputs)

--base-domain.help: Base domain for the git server (defaults to "github.com" for GitHub, "gitlab.com" for GitLab, "bitbucket.org" for Bitbucket, and "dev.azure.com" for Azure DevOps)

--body-file.help: Read a PR description body from a file.

--browsergym-eval-env.help: BrowserGym environment used for browser evaluation

--config-file.help: Path to the config file (default: config.toml in the current directory)

--dataset_name.help: Name of the dataset to download

--directory.help: The working directory for the agent

--enable_volumes.help: Enable persistent volumes for the container to store workspace data. Default: false

--env-llm-config.help: LLM config for evaluation environment (NPC & llm-based evaluator)

--eval-ids.help: The comma-separated list (in quotes) of IDs of the instances to evaluate

--eval-n-limit.help: The number of instances to evaluate

--eval-note.help: The note to add to the evaluation directory

--eval-num-workers.help: The number of workers to use for evaluation

--eval-output-dir.help: The directory to save evaluation output

--eval-split.help: data split to evaluate on, must be test

--event-path.help: Read the PR description body from a GitHub event payload.

--file.help: Path to a file containing the task. Overrides -t if both are provided.

--files-file.help: Read changed file paths (one per line) from a file. If omitted in CI, the script fetches them from the GitHub API.

--filter_dataset_after_sampling.help: if provided, filter dataset after sampling instead of before

--force.help: Force update all reports even if no changes are detected

--fork-owner.help: Owner of the fork to push changes to (if different from the original repo owner).

--gpu.help: Enable GPU support by mounting all GPUs into the Docker container via nvidia-docker

--hardness.help: Which level of difficulty to evaluate from ToolQA. ToolQA contains 2 levels of hardness, namely easy and hard. For example, the default is --hardness easy.

--hubs.help: Which hubs to evaluate from APIBench. APIBench contains 3 hubs, namely huggingface, torch, and tensorflow. You could choose one or more from hf, torch, or tf, separated by commas. For example, the default is --hub hf,torch,tf.

--input_path.help: Name of input path to JSON file.

--install-pyinstaller.help: Install PyInstaller using uv before building

--is-experimental.help: Whether to run in experimental mode.

--issue-type.help: Type of issue to resolve, either open issue or pr comments.

--json_file_path.help: Path to the jsonl file containing the evaluation results

--llm-config.help: Replace default LLM ([llm] section in config.toml) config with the specified LLM config, e.g. "llama3" for [llm.llama3] section in config.toml

--max-budget-per-task.help: The maximum budget allowed per task, beyond which the agent will stop.

--max-chars.help: The maximum number of characters to send to and receive from LLM per task

--max-infer-turn.help: Max number of turns allowed for coding agent.

--max-iterations.help: The maximum number of iterations to run the agent

--max-propose-solution.help: maximum number of times the agent can propose a solution

--max-wait-seconds.help: Maximum time to wait per polling phase; if a start task must be awaited first, the total runtime can approach twice this value

--mode.help: mode to run the evaluation, either 'swe', 'swt', or 'swt-ci'

--mount-cwd.help: Mount the current working directory into the GUI server container

--new_namespace.help: The new Docker Hub namespace to push the images

--no-auto-continue.help: Disable auto-continue responses in headless mode (i.e. headless will read from stdin instead of auto-continuing)

--oh_output_file.help: Path to the OH output file

--only-x-instances.help: Only show instances that are ran by X

--output.help: Path where the JSON result should be written

--output-dir.help: Output directory to write the results.

--output-path.help: Output directory for generated T-Bench tasks.

--output_path.help: Name of output path to JSON file.

--outputs-path.help: Folder path to save trajectories and evaluation results

--override-cli-mode.help: Override the default settings for CLI mode

--overwrite-backup.help: Automatically overwrite existing backup files without prompting

--poll-interval-seconds.help: Polling interval while waiting for the conversation to finish

--pr-title.help: Custom title for the pull request

--pr-type.help: Type of the pull request to send [branch, draft, ready]

--predictions-path.help: Path to the directory containing the output.jsonl with the predictions.

--prompt-file.help: Path to the prompt template file in Jinja format.

--repo-instruction-file.help: Path to the repository instruction file in text format.

--repo-split.help: all, lite, or each repo name

--repo-url.help: The URL of the Git repository containing AlgoTune tasks.

--reviewer.help: GitHub, GitLab, or Azure DevOps username of the person to request review from

--send-on-failure.help: Send a pull request even if the issue was not successfully resolved.

--server-hostname.help: Server hostname, e.g. localhost to access the host machine from the container, assuming the task docker container is run with `--network host` flag

--show-paths.help: Show visualization paths for failed instances

--split.help: this is the HF dataset split

--start_instance_id.help: The instance_id to start processing from

--subset.help: subset of the dataset to be used

--target-branch.help: Target branch to create the pull request against (defaults to repository default branch)

--task.help: The task for the agent to perform

--testfile_start.help: Whether to start from the 0 shot test file

--versions-dir.help: Path to the enterprise Alembic versions directory.

--wolfram-alpha-appid.help: wolfram alpha appid to use for wolfram alpha related tests

--zero_shot_path.help: Path to the zero shot test file predictions

-N.help: Do not execute a remote command (useful for port forwarding)

-v.help: Verbose mode (add more v's for increased verbosity)

cli.help: Run OpenHands in CLI mode (terminal interface)

input_path.help: The file or directory to summarize

output_filepath.help: Path to save the output file

serve.help: Launch the OpenHands GUI server using Docker (web interface)

threshold.help: Minimum number of times an ID must be resolved to be skipped
